invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new HoodieJavaWriteClient instance, so result cannot be null.
The returned object is instantiated as HoodieJavaWriteClient, so result is always an instance of that class.
config is passed as an argument to the HoodieJavaWriteClient constructor and would typically not be null for correct functioning.
context is passed as an argument to the HoodieJavaWriteClient constructor and must not be null for instantiation.
result is a new HoodieJavaWriteClient, while config is a HoodieWriteConfig; they are not the same object.
